# NAMI Metro Baltimore

> > NAMI Metro Baltimore provides mental health support, education, and advocacy services throughout the Baltimore region, including peer support groups, family education programs, and community outreach.

The National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI) Metro Baltimore chapter serves individuals living with mental health conditions, their families, and the broader community through evidence-based programs like Peer-to-Peer and Family-to-Family classes. The organization focuses on stigma reduction, legislative advocacy, and specialized support for veterans, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and youth.

## Key Topics

- NAMI Peer-to-Peer recovery program
- Family-to-Family caregiver education
- Mental health advocacy and policy
- Peer support groups
- LGBTQIA+ mental health resources
- Veterans mental health support
- Youth and young adult programs
- Faith community partnerships
- West Baltimore community outreach
- StigmaFree initiatives
- Mental health education classes
- NAMIWalks fundraising events
- Virtual and in-person support groups

## Core Programs & Services

- [Advocacy](https://namibaltimore.org/what-we-do/advocacy): Mental health advocacy, legislative action, and grassroots training programs
- [Youth & Young Adults](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-serve/youth-young-adults): Mental health programs and stigma reduction for youth and young adults
- [Community Members](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-serve/community-members): Community education programs including faith leader conferences and guides
- [LGBTQIA+ Mental Health Matters](https://namibaltimore.org/lgbtqia-resources): LGBTQIA+ mental health resources and StigmaFree support programs

## Support Groups & Classes

- [VIRTUAL NAMI Family Support Group](https://namibaltimore.org/events/thursday-virtual-nami-family-support-group): Virtual Zoom support group for families navigating loved ones' mental health
- [NAMI Veteran Connection Support Group](https://namibaltimore.org/events/nami-veteran-connection-support-group): Peer support group for veterans with mental health conditions in Baltimore
- [POP-UP NAMI Family Support Group in West Baltimore](https://namibaltimore.org/events/pop-up-nami-family-support-group-in-west-baltimore-701-879): In-person family support group at Bon Secours Center in West Baltimore
- [First Day of NAMI Peer-to-Peer Classes (September)](https://namibaltimore.org/events/first-day-of-nami-peer-to-peer-may-classes-493-942): 8-session Peer-to-Peer mental health recovery class starting September 25th
- [First Day of NAMI Peer-to-Peer Classes (Autumn)](https://namibaltimore.org/events/first-day-of-nami-peer-to-peer-may-classes-493-942-251-472): Autumn Peer-to-Peer class start date for mental health recovery program
- [Last Day to Enroll for July NAMI Peer-to-Peer Class](https://namibaltimore.org/events/last-day-to-enroll-for-nami-peer-to-peer-a-class-for-people-with-mental-health-conditions-297-620): Enrollment deadline for 8-week virtual Peer-to-Peer recovery class
- [Last Day to Enroll in NAMI Family-to-Family May Classes](https://namibaltimore.org/events/first-day-of-nami-peer-to-peer-may-classes-566-880): Enrollment deadline for Family-to-Family caregiver education classes

## Community Events

- [NAMIWalks Greater Baltimore](https://namibaltimore.org/events/namiwalks-greater-baltimore): Annual mental health fundraising walk event on October 11th in Baltimore
- [West Baltimore Town Hall Breakfast](https://namibaltimore.org/events/west-baltimore-town-hall-breakfast): Annual breakfast event for faith leaders in West Baltimore community
- [Men's Mental Health Lunch & Learn](https://namibaltimore.org/events/mens-mental-health-lunch-learn): Men's mental health education event with MorganCARES in East Baltimore

## About & Resources

- [Leadership](https://namibaltimore.org/who-we-are/leadership): NAMI Metro Baltimore staff directory and organizational leadership team
- [Publications](https://namibaltimore.org/learn-more/publications): Mental health policy reports, surveys, and resource guides from NAMI
- [In the News](https://namibaltimore.org/learn-more/in-the-news): Media coverage and news appearances by NAMI Metro Baltimore
